name: lumine-mcp
author: lumine-code
description: Model Context Protocol server exposing editor tools to AI assistants.
backgroundTips: You can choose which editor tools an AI assistant may call with {{ 'lumine-mcp:toggle-tools' | keystroke }}

autoStart.title: Auto Start
autoStart.description: Automatically start the MCP bridge server when Lumine opens

bridgePort.title: Bridge Base Port
bridgePort.description: Base port for MCP bridge. Auto-increments for multiple windows (e.g., 3000, 3001, 3002)

listMode.title: List Mode
listMode.description: How the tool list is interpreted: blacklist disables listed tools, greenlist enables only listed tools

toolList.title: Tool List
toolList.description: MCP tool names interpreted as blacklist or greenlist depending on List Mode (managed via toggle-tools command). The defaults are the tools that discard something: a closed tab, a project root, a kernel's variables, or the state of the session an assistant runs code in

debugMode.title: Debug Mode
debugMode.description: Enable debug logging to console for troubleshooting
